title: Shophand $5K Small Business Boost Grant
description: Small business grant worth $5,000: $2,500 in unrestricted cash plus $2,500 in Shophand technical support and services. Apply through the Shophand Member Hub in about 10-15 minutes; winners announced December 15.
eligibility: For-profit U.S. businesses that are actively operating (not just an idea), with fewer than 50 employees and under $5 million in annual revenue. Nonprofits are not eligible.

raw.note: Page lists round 2 deadline 'November 30' without a year; 2026 per aggregators.

title: Tory Burch Foundation Fellows Program
description: Fellowship for women entrepreneurs: a $2,000 education grant plus a year-long program of mentoring and support. Women-owned business owners apply online.
eligibility: For-profit small business at least 51% owned and controlled by women, earning at least $75,000 a year, formed and operating in the U.S.; owner 21 or older.

raw.note: Official page gives deadline Nov 17, 2026; the $2,000 figure comes from a roundup, not the official page.

title: Hiring Our Heroes Small Business Grant Program (2027)
funder: U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation, Hiring Our Heroes
description: Five grants for veteran-owned and military spouse-owned small businesses: four winners get $10,000 each and one grand prize winner gets $25,000. No entry fee.
eligibility: Veteran- or military spouse-owned for-profit business (owner holds 51%+), 3 to 20 employees, under $5 million revenue, in a distressed-community zip code or showing financial need.

raw.note: Entry deadline 11:59 pm EDT Dec 15, 2026; winners notified by March 29, 2027.

title: Hustler's MicroGrant
description: $1,000 microgrant awarded every month to small business owners and entrepreneurs in the U.S. who are building, growing or stabilizing a business. $15 nonrefundable application fee.
eligibility: Small business owners and entrepreneurs in the United States with a clear plan for how the grant would help; U.S. mailing address required.

raw.note: Rolling; no closing date published.

title: The Hopper Prize Fall 2026 Artist Grants
description: Unrestricted grants for visual artists: two $4,500 grants and four $1,000 grants, any medium. $40 submission fee.
eligibility: Visual artists aged 18 or older working in any media.

raw.note: For individual artists, not businesses. Deadline Nov 17, 11:59 pm PST (year not printed on page; 2026 per 4Culture listing).

title: Small Business Facade Improvement Program (Richmond, CA)
description: Grants of up to $15,000 per address for storefront exterior improvements (windows, doors, awnings, signage, painting, lighting) for retail and public-facing small businesses in Iron Triangle, Santa Fe or Coronado.
eligibility: Retail and public-facing businesses and nonprofits in ground-floor street-facing space, or owners of vacant storefronts, in those Richmond neighborhoods; 2024 revenue $2 million or less; active city business license.

raw.note: City page (updated June 25, 2026): accepting applications through December 2026 or until funds run out; requests exceed the $300,000 pool, new applications may be waitlisted.

title: Amber Grant for Women
description: Monthly $15,000 grant for woman-owned businesses, plus a $75,000 year-end grant. Women business owners in any category can apply.
eligibility: Woman-owned business in any category; the page says nonprofits are also eligible.

raw.note: Rolling monthly; the page states no cutoff date, fee or open/closed status, and is inconsistent on number of monthly winners.

title: Columbia County Microenterprise Grant (NY)
description: Grant of up to $20,000 for very small businesses in Columbia County, New York. Owners complete a four-session training program.
eligibility: Columbia County, NY businesses with five or fewer employees (including owners) that commit to creating at least one job for a low- to moderate-income person; credit score of 600+ (exceptions possible).

raw.note: Deadline Dec 15, 2026 per CEDC page.

title: Vermont Working Lands Business Enhancement Grant
description: Grants of $10,000 to $50,000, no match required, for Vermont farm, food, forestry and wood-products businesses to grow. Decisions late Feb or early March 2027.
eligibility: Vermont farms producing food or fiber, forestry businesses using Vermont-grown wood, and certain agricultural trucking, distribution and retail businesses with at least one year of operating history. Cannabis, flowers, horticulture and indoor-only growers are excluded.

raw.note: Window Oct 9 - Dec 10, 2026, 2:00 pm.

title: USDA Organic Certification Cost Share Program (OCCSP)
description: Reimburses certified organic farms, producers and handlers for part of their organic certification costs. Apply through your local FSA service center.
eligibility: USDA-certified organic producers and handlers (farm businesses); needs proof of certification and itemized invoices.

raw.note: Deadline Dec 31, 2026 for program years 2025 and 2026 (FSA via search summary; official page fetch timed out). $750 cap per scope is from an aggregator.

title: Verizon Small Business Digital Ready $10,000 Grants
description: $10,000 small business grants from Verizon. Complete two Digital Ready courses or events to unlock the application; apply once to stay eligible for the year.
eligibility: U.S. small business owners who first finish two Verizon Digital Ready courses or events.

raw.note: Sources conflict: rolling for 2026 vs deadlines of Dec 1 or Dec 7, 2026. Check before applying.

title: North Dakota APUC Value-Added Agriculture Grant
description: State grants for North Dakota companies that add value to North Dakota farm products. Quarterly application deadlines.
eligibility: North Dakota companies and farm businesses that add value to North Dakota agriculture.

raw.note: Ambrook and Atom Grants agree on Jan 1, 2027; the two list different quarterly schedules.

title: Missouri MASBDA Farm to Table Value-Added Grant
funder: Missouri Agricultural and Small Business Development Authority
description: Missouri value-added agriculture grant program run by MASBDA, for projects that add value to Missouri farm products.
eligibility: Missouri agriculture projects and small businesses; see the MASBDA guidelines for exact eligibility.

raw.note: Dec 15, 2026, 3 pm from two aggregator listings (Atom Grants, GrantCompass); not on the official page I could read.

title: The Flagship Fund Microgrants (Erie, PA)
description: Microgrants of up to $5,000 with a 1:1 match for Erie small businesses and entrepreneurs: marketing, building improvements, equipment, computer hardware or software and connectivity. Awarded in competitive application rounds.
eligibility: Small businesses and entrepreneurs in the City of Erie; businesses that got a Flagship grant in the last three years are excluded.

raw.note: Program is real and recurring, but no 2026 application window was confirmed; 2025 round awarded 39 businesses.

title: Chicago Small Business Improvement Fund (SBIF)
funder: City of Chicago Department of Planning and Development
description: Reimbursement grants for permanent building improvements and repairs to a business property in an open Chicago TIF district. Industrial businesses with 200 or fewer employees can get 50% of project costs.
eligibility: Owners and tenants of qualifying commercial or industrial property in a Chicago TIF district that is currently open for applications.

raw.note: Windows open district by district through 2026; maximum award not confirmed. Apply via SomerCor; see chicago.gov/sbif calendar.

title: Secretsos Small Business Grant
description: Quarterly $2,500 grant for small businesses owned by women, veterans or minorities, or businesses that were turned down for a bank loan.
eligibility: U.S. small business owners who are women-, veteran- or minority-owned, or were denied a bank loan.

raw.note: Deadline Dec 31, 2026 per GrantCompass; a second roundup agrees. Official page not read.

title: Business Freedom Grant
description: $1,000 grant for small business owners and idea-stage founders. No entry fee.
eligibility: Any U.S. business owner or founder; idea stage welcome.

raw.note: Deadline Dec 31, 2026 (an interim round closes Nov 15, 2026). Two roundups agree; official page not read.

title: Outta Excuses Small Business Empowerment Grant
description: $3,000 grant per round for small businesses. $15 entry fee.
eligibility: Registered LLC with under $500,000 in annual revenue.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Deadline Dec 31, 2026, 11:59 pm EST.

title: IFW Startup Accelerator Grant
description: $5,000 grant for one winning startup or small business. $5 entry fee; idea-stage founders welcome.
eligibility: Any U.S. business owner holding 50% or more of a business; idea stage welcome.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Deadline Nov 30, 2026.

title: Coach K Legacy Grant
description: Monthly $1,000 grant for small business owners.
eligibility: U.S. small business owners.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Current round closes Nov 28, 2026, 11:59 pm ET.

title: Freed Fellowship Grant
description: $500 each month plus a $2,500 year-end award for U.S. for-profit small businesses.
eligibility: Any U.S. for-profit business.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Monthly rolling; applications close the last day of each month.

title: NASE Growth Grant
description: Grants of up to $4,000 for self-employed people and micro-business owners to grow their business, reviewed quarterly.
eligibility: NASE members only (self-employed individuals and micro-businesses).

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Rolling; reviewed in Jan, Apr, Jul and Oct.

title: Awesome Foundation Micro-Grant
description: $1,000 no-strings micro-grants, usually monthly, for community projects, creative projects and local initiatives. No entry fee.
eligibility: Anyone with a community or creative project; not limited to businesses.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Rolling; most local chapters choose monthly.

title: Black Women Photographers x Nikon Grant
description: Grant of $2,500 cash plus a Nikon Z6III camera kit for Black women photographers.
eligibility: Aimed at Black women photographers (per the program name); check the official rules.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Deadline Nov 20, 2026.

title: Seated Together Small Business Microgrant
description: Microgrant of $750 ($1,000 for veteran-owned businesses) for U.S. for-profit small businesses, reviewed quarterly. $5 entry fee.
eligibility: Any U.S. for-profit business; veteran-owned businesses receive a higher amount.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Rolling, reviewed quarterly.

title: Montana Tribal Tourism Small Business Grant
description: State grant to promote tribal tourism: small business products and projects run by Montana tribal tourism businesses. Needs a 10% cash match above $25,000.
eligibility: Individuals and businesses representing a Montana tribal tourism business.

raw.note: Amounts conflict: up to $30,000 (GrantCompass) vs up to $10,000 (older GrantWatch listing). Deadline Nov 30, 2026.

title: Tampa Entrepreneur Support Hub Microgrant
description: Microgrants of $1,500 to $3,000 for Tampa entrepreneurs and small businesses; referral-based through the entrepreneur support hub.
eligibility: Tampa, Florida small businesses and entrepreneurs, referred through the city's support hub.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Listed deadline Feb 15, 2027.

title: Colorado CGBN Efficiency Grant
funder: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment
description: Grants of $1,500 to $4,500 for Colorado small businesses to pay for energy and resource efficiency upgrades, depending on the business's EnviroScreen score.
eligibility: Colorado small businesses, with higher amounts for businesses in disproportionately impacted areas.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. Listed deadline May 1, 2027.

title: Idaho Employer Training Grant
description: Grants of up to $500,000 for Idaho employers to train workers and upskill employees.
eligibility: Idaho businesses and employers training their workforce.

raw.note: GrantCompass and a second roundup. Deadline Dec 4, 2026, 5 pm MT.

title: Global NY STEP Export Grant
description: Reimbursement grants of $2,000 to $5,000 per activity for New York small businesses that want to start or grow exporting: trade shows, international marketing and translation.
eligibility: New York small businesses new to exporting or expanding exports.

raw.note: GrantCompass only. First-come until funds committed; listed through Sept 29, 2027.
